PASS-1 review note (T8 — LLM/prompt structural-completeness), for author triage only:

The model-parity invariant (Invariant 2) uniformly keys the "refuse to start on model mismatch" rule on the corpus baseline's `provider_provenance.ran_model`, but that field's value vocabulary does not contain a Pass-1 (frontier/Opus) value. In this corpus `provider_provenance.ran_model` records whichever pass LAST touched the review's overall provenance — empirically always the standard (Sonnet) class; Pass-1's per-call frontier model id is not separately persisted per finding. So the parity baseline the plan names is undefined for the Pass-1/Tier-2 (Opus) re-run, and a `ran_model`-keyed refusal cannot be evaluated for that pass. The plan should state the Pass-1 parity baseline explicitly (e.g. resolve-and-pin the production frontier class rather than compare against a per-review `ran_model`, and acknowledge Tier-2 is not filtered by `ran_model`). Evidence: `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier2.py:70-77` ("UNLIKE Tier-1 ... no row records a frontier-class `ran_model`") vs `tier1.py:60` which filters on `ran_model == standard_class_model`.
